dedupe_keys.name: chinese building energy efficient design datasets cbed

description: Xi’an University of Architecture and Technology researchers publish the CBED portal code for distributing Chinese building-energy-design data. The May 2025 Zenodo archive and linked repository document SQL tables, a web and mobile frontend, and a Java backend built with Maven and Spring Boot. The portal supports weather records, HVAC design conditions, typical meteorological years and thermal-comfort information used in building simulations. Zenodo labels the archive AGPL-3.0-or-later, while the current repository README and GitHub licence identify GPL-3.0. Both are open licences, but their disagreement must be resolved for the chosen version. The public repository is archived. Coverage is Chinese building-design information; station counts, periods and access terms for every hosted dataset remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the portal. Software availability does not establish complete access to underlying observations. No installation or portal registration was attempted.
